messages:
Maya Lopez: hi all, first day! trying to set up Notion and noticed I can't duplicate the onboarding playbook. is duplication restricted company-wide? :thinking: 
Ravi Shah: welcome Maya :tada: we usually lock duplication for some canonical pages. which playbook? can you paste the link?
Maya Lopez: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/engineering-onboarding-playbook 
Leah Park: paging @Ravi since he's on docs-rotations today. most folks get added to the docs-editers group for duplication. Ravi, can you check Maya's access?
Ravi Shah: yep i see. you were added as a viewer by default from the org import. i just added you to docs-editors; refresh and try duplicate again.
Maya Lopez: refreshed, still no Duplicate button :grimacing: it shows Share and Export only.
Ravi Shah: hm. sometimes page-level copy is disabled even for editors. @Leah can you check page settings?
Leah Park: checked — page-level copy was toggled off during a mass-lock last month. flipped it on now for this page. Maya try again. :white_check_mark:
Maya Lopez: nice! I can duplicate now. thanks both. quick q: where do our team-level templates live? i want the infra runbook template.
Leah Park: templates live in the sidebar under "Templates" and canonical copies are under /handbook/templates. infra runbook path: notion://redwood/handbook/templates/infra/runbook-template
Maya Lopez: should i duplicate into my personal workspace or straight into /handbook/drafts?
Ravi Shah: duplicate into personal, draft, then move to /handbook/drafts when ready. create a short PR in the docs repo linking the draft so reviewers can comment.
Maya Lopez: is there a naming convention for moved drafts?
Leah Park: yes: YEAR-MONTH-teamname-shorttitle, e.g., 2026-03-infra-s3-rotate. put an ownership line at top and Estimated Reviewers.
Maya Lopez: perfect. one last thing — any step-by-step checklist I should follow after duplicating templates so I don't miss infra-specific fields?
docs-bot: Tip: follow the "New hire docs checklist" in /handbook/new-hire-checklist. It includes sections for team-specific fields, PR steps, and naming. Mark the checklist items done after completing.
Maya Lopez: thanks! also infra uses secrets manager links, any docs on where to store credentials when drafting?
InfraBot: See /handbook/security/secret-storage for approved patterns. Do not include secrets in Notion; use placeholders and link to the secret reference.
Maya Lopez: got it. really appreciate the quick help :pray:
